summary:
Three structurally distinct final versions of Edition 02 with matching Notes sets.

Version A ('The Open Loop'): Opens with 'A two-year-old and Justin Bieber taught me the same thing at Coachella last weekend.' Pairs Shelter + dashstar early as one emotional beat. Insight lands via self-reflective turn ('I'd been one of those people'). Clean fast close.

Version B ('The Scene Builder'): Opens with the Shelter scene for emotional immersion. Chronological flow with the open loop planted after the wedding backstory. dashstar arrives as 'then it happened again' after the Bieber parallel. Warmer authentic close from the original with Ryan's photo and 'somehow the weekend had worked out.'

Version C ('The Skeptic's Flip'): Opens with the Coachella judgment so the reader identifies with the skeptic's POV before the narrative breaks it apart. Shelter moment hits harder because the reader has been in the resistant headspace. Direct reader-turn question before the close.

Each version has 3 dedicated Notes plus 1 universal Bridge Note for Ed 03. Notes are standalone micro-provocations, not essay summaries. Comparison table at the end for quick decision-making.
